ayahs.1: Yaqeenan hum ne Nuh (alaihis salaam) ko un ki qaum ki taraf bheja ke apni qaum ko dara do (aur khabardar kar do) is se pehle ke un ke paas dardnaak azaab aa jaaye.
ayahs.2: (Nuh alaihis salaam ne) kaha ae meri qaum! Main tumhein saaf saaf daraane wala hoon.
ayahs.3: Ke tum Allah ki ibaadat karo aur usi se daro aur mera kaha maano.
ayahs.4: To woh tumhare gunah bakhsh dega aur tumhein ek waqt-e-muqarrara tak chhod dega. Yaqeenan Allah ka waada jab aa jaata hai to muakhkhar nahin hota. Kaash ke tumhein samajh hoti.
ayahs.5: (Nuh alaihis salaam ne) kaha ae mere Parwardigaar! Main ne apni qaum ko raat din teri taraf bulaya hai.
ayahs.6: Magar mere bulaane se yeh log aur zyada bhaagne lage.
ayahs.7: Main ne jab kabhi unhein teri bakhshish ke liye bulaya unhon ne apni ungliyan apne kaanon mein daal leen aur apne kapdon ko odh liya aur ad gaye aur bada takabbur kiya.
ayahs.8: Phir main ne unhein ba-aawaz-e-buland bulaya.
ayahs.9: Aur beshak main ne un se elaniya bhi kaha aur chupke chupke bhi.
ayahs.10: Aur main ne kaha ke apne Rabb se apne gunah bakhshwao (aur maafi maango) woh yaqeenan bada bakhshne wala hai.
ayahs.11: Woh tum par aasman ko khoob barasta hua chhod dega.
ayahs.12: Aur tumhein khoob pai-dar-pai maal aur aulaad mein taraqqi dega aur tumhein baaghaat dega aur tumhare liye nahren nikaal dega.
ayahs.13: Tumhein kya ho gaya hai ke tum Allah ki bartari ka aqeeda nahin rakhte.
ayahs.14: Halaanke us ne tumhein tarah tarah se paida kiya hai.
ayahs.15: Kya tum nahin dekhte ke Allah Taala ne oopar tale kis tarah saat aasman paida kar diye hain.
ayahs.16: Aur un mein chaand ko jagmagaata banaya hai aur sooraj ko roshan chiraagh banaya hai.
ayahs.17: Aur tum ko zameen se ek (khaas ehtemaam se) ugaya hai (aur paida kiya hai).
ayahs.18: Phir tumhein usi mein lauta le jaayega aur (ek khaas tareeqe) se phir nikaalega.
ayahs.19: Aur tumhare liye zameen ko Allah Taala ne farsh bana diya hai.
ayahs.20: Taake tum us ki kushaada raahon mein chalo phiro.
ayahs.21: Nuh (alaihis salaam) ne kaha ae mere Parwardigaar! In logon ne meri to nafarmani ki aur aison ki farmanbardari ki jin ke maal-o-aulaad ne un ko (yaqeenan) nuqsan hi mein badhaya hai.
ayahs.22: Aur in logon ne bada sakht fareb kiya.
ayahs.23: Aur kaha unhon ne ke hargiz apne mabudon ko na chhodna aur na Wadd aur Suwaa aur Yaghoos aur Yauq aur Nasr ko (chhodna).
ayahs.24: Aur unhon ne bahut se logon ko gumrah kiya (Ilahi) to un zaalimon ki gumrahi aur badha.
ayahs.25: Yeh log ba-sabab apne gunahon ke dubo diye gaye aur jahannam mein pahuncha diye gaye aur Allah ke siwa apna koi madadgaar unhon ne na paya.
ayahs.26: Aur (Hazrat) Nuh (alaihis salaam) ne kaha ke ae mere paalne wale! Tu roo-e-zameen par kisi kaafir ko rehne sehne wala na chhod.
ayahs.27: Agar tu unhein chhod dega to (yaqeenan) yeh tere (aur) bandon ko (bhi) gumrah kar denge aur yeh faajiron aur dheet kaafiron hi ko janam denge.
ayahs.28: Ae mere Parwardigaar! Tu mujhe aur mere maa baap aur jo bhi imaan ki haalat mein mere ghar mein aaye aur tamaam momin mardon aur aurton ko bakhsh de aur kaafiron ko siwaye barbaadi ke aur kisi baat mein na badha.
